Sam.Sales: Heads up — POC kickoff with CrossOrg tomorrow 10am PST. They dumped a security questionnaire and a long list of TODOs: SSO (SAML), SCIM delta window, RBAC attribute mapping, domain proofing. Can we quickly align on answers?
Maria.Solutions: Thanks Sam. Main asks I saw: 1) SAML assertion size/attribute limits 2) SCIM delta sync window + retry/backoff 3) How RBAC maps from IdP groups -> Redwood roles 4) If they need dedicated capacity for heavy provisioning.
Raj.SE: For SCIM: default rate limit is 600 reqs/min in hosted, burst handled by token buckets. Delta endpoint uses since= timestamp param. Typical guidance: batch full-sync for >50k users, otherwise deltas every 5m.
Cody.Engineering: Quick tech note: very large SAML assertions (>>16KB) can cause saml-lib chew + slow parsing on some IdPs. We recommend sending group claims as urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:oracle:2.0:Group or reference by group IDs instead of full list when >200 groups.
Sam.Sales: @Nina.Security can you confirm what to put in the questionnaire re: KMS/audit logs? They asked if we support HSM-backed keys.
Nina.Security: We don't provide customer-managed HSM in hosted. We do support customer KMS integration for Private deployments (Cloud KMS / BYOK). Audit logs: we retain admin audit logs 90 days by default, can extend with enterprise add-on. I'll paste exact language in a followup.
Maria.Solutions: On RBAC mapping: we usually offer: IdP group -> Redwood role mapping via SCIM group.sync OR admin UI mapping. For POC, we can demo automatic mapping using a UID map in the SCIM group payload. Example payload snippet: ```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations":[{"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-123"}]}]}
```
Raj.SE: SCIM delta example query: `GET /scim/v2/Users?filter=meta.lastModified>2026-03-01T12:00:00Z`. For deltas we support `startIndex`+`count` for paging and `If-None-Match`/ETag for conditional requests. Retries: exponential backoff with jitter; we recommend  Retry-After on 429.
Sam.Sales: Pricing angle: customer asking whether heavy SCIM provisioning (500k accounts initial + daily 20k deltas) requires Dedicated. @Cody.Engineering thoughts on throughput?
Cody.Engineering: For that volume we should push Dedicated or Private: Dedicated gives reserved GPU pools for consistent latency of auth checks and avoids noisy-neighbor API throttling. If they accept higher latency on initial bulk job, hosted + rate-limited bulk window overnight could work but will stretch out sync time. Estimated cost delta: Dedicated monthly commit vs hosted overage — I'll get ballpark numbers.
Maria.Solutions: Suggested POC plan: 1) Domain proofing: they must complete DNS TXT verification for domains they claim; we can demo via temp TXT. 2) SAML: ask them to send sample assertion (redact PII) so we can test attribute mapping. 3) SCIM: provide test CSV for 10k users, run full import to show mapping. 4) Security Q: Nina to provide writeup.
Nina.Security: I'll add two sentences for the questionnaire: (a) Hosted: KMS integrations via API, no HSM; (b) Private: supports customer KMS/HSM and SOC2/ISO controls; (c) Logs: admin/audit/logging retention options and S3 export.
OpsBot: Deploy bot: Reminder — Demo environment provisioned: demo-crossorg-2026 (expires in 14 days).
Raj.SE: One sticky edgecase: SCIM delta windows on flaky networks — if provider sends events out-of-order we rely on meta.lastModified and ETag monotonicity. Recommend they keep clocks NTP-synced. Mention to them: avoid clock skew >30s.
Sam.Sales: Action items: Maria to request sample SAML assertion & domain TXT; Raj to draft SCIM delta guidance + rate plan; Nina to draft security answers; Cody to give cost/throughput estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted. I'll follow up with CrossOrg legal about data residency.
Maria.Solutions: I'll DM them the onboarding checklist and the short questionnaire we use for presales. Link: https://redwood.ai/docs/presales/scim-saml-auth-playbook
Cody.Engineering: For the assertion size hack: if they cannot compress claims, we can accept a pointer claim (group_refs) referencing groups in SCIM; that keeps assertion small and looks like: `groups=["grp-234","grp-345"]` instead of full lists.
Sam.Sales: Great — please post your drafts in this thread before EOD. I want final answers by 9am tomorrow for the kickoff. :thumbsup:
Maria.Solutions: Will do.
Nina.Security: Drafting now, will post within 2h.
Raj.SE: Draft SCIM doc posting in 30m.
Cody.Engineering: I'll ping infra for Dedicated pricing numbers, posting within the hour.
